definitions.ask: Should Enter on a RECENT row honor its preview-first/confirm guard, with Ctrl+Enter as the immediate rerun?
definitions.why: Matches the sheet's ↵ run / ⌃↵ run now contract and keeps writers like gkeep pull previewed

choices.label: Enter previews or asks to confirm like the catalog row; Ctrl+Enter reruns at once
Enter and Ctrl+Enter both rerun the recorded command at once, skipping its guard

definitions.ask: Should Retry/Apply toasts, Rerun last command, and pager r stop refusing applied preview-first or confirm runs?
definitions.why: These replays are refused today with no way forward; the Apply toast exists only to apply

choices.label: Replays of an applied run skip the guard it cleared; the task-reroll Apply toast starts working
Only RECENT rows and in-sheet r change; those surfaces keep refusing applied runs
